create_gtn_graph: create a gtn Graph object to build a finite state transducer
add_node_to_graph: add a node to a gtn graph with optional start and accept flags
add_arc_to_graph: add an arc between two nodes in a gtn graph with a symbol label
draw_graph_to_pdf: draw a gtn graph and export it to a PDF file with symbol labels
union_graphs: union multiple gtn graphs into a single combined graph
